title: Confidence check
instruction: Before you start, rate how confident you feel about each statement. There are no right or wrong answers.

_items.text: I can tell when using AI supports my learning and when it does the thinking for me.
I can read AI output critically for accuracy, bias and what it leaves out.
I can name the ways AI fails, and decide when it is wiser not to use it.
I can place my own use of AI against the four levels of AI literacy.
I can identify which failure mode is at work in a piece of AI output.
I can weigh how a use of AI affects my learning, integrity, privacy and the environment.

_preConfirmation: Thank you. You will see these statements again at the end of the course, so you can see how your confidence has changed.
